contents.text:
I'm checking whether the docs mention Unity, and so far they don't, so I won't make anything up. The Overview lists the framework's five families or projects, which is where it says what it ships, and the features page has a where-it-runs section I could point to. The instruction asks for a doc path at the end, but the search results I have don't show one, so I'm considering citing the docs index at src/docs/README.md, though I haven't opened that file yet. Reading it quickly would let me point to the actual project list.

I'm checking whether the docs say anything about Unity, and they don't, so I'll say that plainly rather than guess. The Overview lists every project the framework ships, which is the right place to point. I could also offer to take them there.

No, the docs don't mention Unity or any game engine plugin. I searched for both and found nothing that ships for Unity. The only "Unity" hits were unrelated plan notes, so I can't say it's supported.

The framework's own list of what it ships is on the Overview, under its five families: the engine, the hosts, the web, the evals and the tools. If a Unity plugin existed, it would be listed there. I'd rather you check that list than trust my reading of a search.

arguments.question: Shall I take you to the full list of what the framework ships?

choices.label: Show me the Overview list
choices.why: The five families and every project they ship.

choices.label: Where can an agent run?
choices.why: The hosts: terminal, Rider, HTTP API and MCP server.

choices.label: Build an agent of my own
choices.why: The guides for an identity, a pack and a site.
